Two young brown bears are seen climbing a tree in a zoo enclosure, with one bear reaching the top while the other climbs below. After reaching the top, the bear descends, and both eventually meet at the base of the tree, where they interact playfully on the grassy ground near a body of water, while visitors observe from an elevated walkway above.

A mother brown bear and her cub are seen in a grassy, wooded area. Initially, the cub playfully nuzzles and climbs on the mother near a tree trunk. They then begin to walk together across the field, with the cub trotting alongside its mother, who leads the way.
